notes.title: Broken Spectre just keeps climbing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44462345/74d5a3391f302290a4913ad0eaa5b5b7e4f08300.png[/img]

In our first three months, Broken Spectre has been selected time and again as a groundbreaking narrative game. We're so honoured to share the following accolades:
[list]
[*] AIXR VR Awards - Shortlisted for Best VR Experience 2023
[*] Raindance Immersive - Shorlisted for Best Immersive Game 2023
[*] The Horror Game Awards - Shortlisted for Player's Choice Best Horror Game of 2023
[*] Haunted House Fear Fest - 2023 WINNER for Best Video Game
[*] Drop Horror Film Festival - 2023 WINNER for Best in VR
[/list]
Alongside these amazing awards, Broken Spectre has been featured in the UploadVR 2023 Summer Showcase, the VR Game Spotlight '23, VRTO and the FIVARS Festival.
